setup: Two similar triangles have corresponding sides in the ratio \([[factor]]\) to 1, and a side of the smaller one is \([[given]]\).

steps.say: Write the corresponding sides as a proportion with the known ratio \([[factor]]\) on one side; the unknown then sits alone in the other fraction.
Check the answer's size before trusting it: with a factor above 1 the image side must be longer than \([[given]]\), and an answer shorter than that means the proportion was written upside down.

answer: So the side corresponding to \([[given]]\) in the larger triangle is \([[side]]\).
